counterexamples.evidence: Board 33333111155: better column 6 and played column 2 are both exactly 2 columns from centre column 4, so run 0s "staying more central" / "the side column" is false. The engine itself set centralityGrounded=false and the O2 branch emitted an EMPTY centrality clause, yet the 2026-08-06 guardrail still said "Explain the blunder through the opening - book line, centrality, parity" and carried no GUARDRAIL_NO_CENTRALITY prohibition. That prohibition is present at HEAD, added by commit 6180fec (2026-08-11), whose comment names eval-21 as the motivating case - i.e. this is a render-layer defect already fixed after the run, not a model failure.

The rendered artifact says only "The more resilient move is column 6; column 2 gives ground faster." - no centrality comparison anywhere in the prompt the model saw; run 0s served text manufactures one.
